value.quote: the domain FK is a maximal Condorcet domain
value.note: Structural characterisations of domains on which majority voting is acyclic: maximality, copiousness, connectedness and single-peakedness on a circle. Domain-restriction results of this kind are read as AX (which domains guarantee a property of majority rule) rather than OT.

C1.reason: The main results characterise domains on which majority rule is acyclic, which fits AX better than a conceptual or modelling contribution (OT), but B's quote was not verbatim and is corrected here.
